blocks.text: Real Russian sentences that use what the lesson teaches. Type the missing word, or pick it, until it turns green.

These are real sentences: from Tatoeba (tatoeba.org, CC BY 2.0 FR), with their English translations, and from the public-domain Russian books in this library, with author and title. Each blank is the word the sentence really has; the word in brackets is its dictionary form.

exercises.q: But fun is not enough.

exercises.q: Tom hangs his clothes, then arranges them by color.

exercises.q: So when you've realized it, you've wolfed down almost all of it.

exercises.q: The suicide bomber fired towards former Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto, but missed.

exercises.q: I want cashews, not almonds.

exercises.q: Sometimes we need to be guided by reason, and sometimes by intuition.

exercises.q: Let the milk stand overnight and skim off the cream.

exercises.q: Zelensky may well be a buffoon, but he is hardly fascist.
exercises.ru: Зеленский, может, и клоун, ___ едва ли фашист.

exercises.q: I didn't want to come here, but I came anyway.
